dialogs.content: No wonder I had a nagging feeling that I should come over and have a look... Well met, "Tum{RUBY#[D]Hope}aini."
Let me guess. You're here for the Flower-Feather Clan's warrior trial?
That's right. I'm here to certify its difficulty!
You won't be disappointed, then. I've got nothing but the highest standards for Qucusaur Riders.
Teaching's not my strong suit, so when I was invited to design these stages, I went with "recalling tough challenges and piling them in one after the other."

The result was... a ninety-nine percent failure rate on the part of our tribe's warriors — on the first stage, no less. As a result... There wasn't any choice but to take Irade's advice and tune the difficulty down a notch.
But I doubt that even the trials as they originally stood would have truly stretched you. If we wanted that... We'd have to go with situations even I would prove helpless in.
Thanks for the kind words, but I don't need special treatment!
No, I do believe you worthy of such respect. I'm no teacher, but I've never misjudged the strength of those I meet.
And as far as yours is concerned... only the most trying of challenges would befit you.
I need to consider the stages' suitability for ordinary warriors, though...
...Fair enough. You've got a task to complete, and we'll have more opportunities in the future.
One day, I'll lay out a banquet table of battle that "transcends" the pinnacle of Qucusaur Rider ability, just for you.
The universality of the stages is not to be overlooked either!
Haha, don't put me on a pedestal, now!
I could've come for you, for all you know.
So you wanna "transcend" my record, then? That's just my speed. I'll have you know that I started by stuffing these stages full of tough challenges that I've faced in the past.
